title: Foundry audit-ledger v2 row (feat-foundry-audit-ledger-taxonomy, AC-ALT-1..3)
description: One JSONL row in .foundry/audit-ledger.jsonl, written exactly once per §8 audit-engine run at the write boundary (scripts/foundry_audit_ledger.py record_audit_v2). A FLAT verdict enum plus an orthogonal kill_reason field present IF AND ONLY IF verdict='killed' (the CI/SARIF pattern — never a delimited sub-string inside the enum member). v1 (legacy) rows are a DIFFERENT, narrower shape (spec_ref/spec_sha256/rounds/operator/verdict='plateau' only, no schema_version) and are NOT validated against this schema — this schema governs v2 rows only (AC-ALT-4 additive migration).

schema_version.description: Discriminates a v2 row from a v1 (legacy, bare-string-verdict) row so readers can dispatch shape deterministically.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the write (AC-ALT-2).

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this engine run. The write boundary enforces uniqueness on this field (AC-ALT-3) — a second write bearing an already-recorded run_id is refused. Best-effort env-derived correlation to the session id when present (residual).

tier.description: The audit-engine model tier/alias this run executed under (e.g. opus|sonnet|haiku|fable — see scripts/foundry-audit-prepare.py ALLOWED_MODEL_ALIASES). Which tier a run reaches is out of this atom's scope; only that every row records the one it ran under.

rounds.description: Number of §8 audit rounds this run executed. May be 0 for a terminus that never ran a round (e.g. dedupe-skip, refused).

findings.description: Findings counts by disposition for this run (AC-ALT-2).

spec_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the audited spec (human audit trail).

spec_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the spec's normative-region content the row is bound to (the content-addressed key /foundry:authorize looks up).

operator.description: Operator id resolved against .claude/foundry-operators.json, or 'agent:<identity>' when unresolvable (AC-ALT-2 — never silently coerced to a registered alias).

verdict.description: The FLAT discriminating terminus enum (AC-ALT-1). The bare legacy string 'plateau' is NOT a member — v1 rows using it are a different (exempt) shape entirely.

kill_reason.description: Present IF AND ONLY IF verdict='killed' (AC-ALT-1). An orthogonal typed field, never a parameterized enum member string.
